findings.text: 公开演示或分享 DSH 截图的人可预设化名与头像，减少侧栏反复手工遮挡；合格结果仍须逐图检查其他个人信息。[Q01](#research-q01)
立即加载浏览器模块，通过 DOM 定位启动器、覆盖文本与头像，以 shell.overlay 注册编辑器；两个字段分别保存在 localStorage。
固定提交的浏览器接线、存储和保存路径源码核查；没有安装、运行测试或真实宿主验收。
package 声明 MIT、lib 分发及浏览器立即加载；源码核查不等于 npm 产物一致性验证。

#### 成本

| 阶段 | 现金与资源成本 | 人工与时间投入 | 已知条件与未知项 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 首次使用 | 宿主设备与浏览器存储，金额未知 | 安装、设置名称头像、检查截图，耗时未知 | 图片上限10MB，重编码目标128×128 |
| 持续使用 | 无独立服务调用机制，总费用未知 | 每图检查其他信息，升级后复核覆盖 | 未测重复截图节时 |
| 失败恢复 | 本地存储与排查资源，金额未知 | 恢复默认、清键、核对部分保存 | 两字段保存不具整体事务 |
经常分享界面的用户可先在非敏感截图中试用，检查保存、取消、恢复默认和重载；不要省略整图复核。出现覆盖消失或保存状态不明时先停用并检查。[Q04](#research-q04)

#### 效果

| 效果项 | 当前证据支持 | 尚不能确定 |
|---|---|---|
| 侧栏显示替换 | DOM 与 localStorage 链路可核查 | 实际宿主兼容 |
| 原头像恢复 | 保留节点、移除覆盖属性 | 所有宿主重渲染组合 |
| 截图脱敏便利 | 减少同一区域重复手改的机制 | 节时、整图遗漏率与单位合格任务成本 |
保留 React 头像子树、缓存启动器和单字段写成功后再更新界面，是有明确维护目的的实现。DOM 后缀与位置回退仍需宿主升级复核；safe 降级避免抛错，却不能证明脱敏成功。跨字段保存应由更高层一致性逻辑负责，见 [Q03](#research-q03)。
相对截图后逐次打码，它把侧栏名称头像脱敏前移到本地界面，并保留 React 原头像子树以便恢复。贡献是可复用的局部展示便利，未证明整图匿名或端到端节时。[Q01](#research-q01) [Q02](#research-q02)
显示覆盖依赖宿主 DOM，而且保存并非整体事务。头像先写成功后别名写失败时，界面可能部分提交；静默选择器回退也不能告诉用户是否已覆盖。源码支持这些边界，尚未复现故障频率。[Q03](#research-q03)
可尝试将名称头像合为版本化记录，持久化成功后一次更新界面，并显示目标 DOM 覆盖状态。应以写入故障和 DOM 变化验证旧状态保留，再比较截图遗漏；若提示使用户忽略整图检查，假设不成立。这是未验证设想。[Q05](#research-q05)

technical.rationale: novelty 相对手工 DOM 覆盖是常规适配；mechanism 保留头像树和探测回退有局部设计价值但不突破隐私约束；transferability 可借鉴 DOM 非破坏覆盖，仍需逐宿主适配；simplification 将两项编辑合在一窗，保存一致性尚有限。

business.rationale: workflow 将截图后遮挡部分前移，是局部增量；delivery 没有改变截图交付物或验收责任；reach 让不写脚本的人可配置侧栏覆盖；economics 只在重复截图时可能省去局部编辑，节时未测。

recommendation.reason: 适合反复演示 DSH 的用户在确认侧栏覆盖与保存恢复行为后试用，每张截图仍需人工检查。

scenario.rationale: 公开演示的重复任务与局部合格标准清楚，实际频率未测。

advantage.rationale: 较每次打码有持久化便利，但覆盖区域有限。

evidence.rationale: 固定源码可追到显示与存储，未执行宿主。

cost.rationale: 没有独立服务配置，本地清理可行；DOM 兼容和截图复核仍占人工。

"path": "README.md", "content": "# dsh-accountdisplayname-edit Replaces the sidebar account label — the phone number, email, or account name DeepSeek Harness shows at the bottom-left — and the avatar above it, with a name and image you choose, so screenshots do not expose the original. The edit entry is a new **Edit display name** row in the account menu, the one you open by clicking that label. The dialog it opens holds both the avatar and the name. ## What it does - Replaces the account label text in the sidebar footer with a display name you set. - Replaces the launcher avatar with an image you pick from a local file. - Adds an **Edit display name** / **编辑显示名称** row to the account menu, directly under Settings. - Opens one editor dialog for both: pick or clear an avatar, type a name, then Save, Cancel, or Use default. `Enter` saves, `Esc` cancels. - Both edits are drafts until Save — Cancel leaves the sidebar untouched. - Saving an empty value restores the account's own text; clearing the avatar restores the account's own avatar. - A picked image is centre-cropped square, downscaled to 128×128 and re-encoded, so the stored copy stays in the low tens of KB. - Stores both per browser in `localStorage`, under `dsh.account-display-name-edit.alias` and `dsh.account-display-name-edit.avatar`. - Display only. The account, the credentials and the profile are never read or changed, and the plugin makes no network requests of its own. ## Requirements Built and verified against DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`. The account launcher and `Menu` DOM it targets — `data-signed-out`, the `_avatar` / `_label` spans, the portaled `div[role="menu"]` with its `role="presentation"` viewport and `itemIcon` / `itemLabel` rows — is unchanged in `0.2.1-rc.2`, which this package was checked against. The host half imports nothing and the browser half fails soft, so a build whose DOM has moved on degrades to "no override, no extra row" rather than an error — see [Compatibility](#compatibility). ## Install ### From the desktop app The `desktop` profile is managed exclusively by the Electron application, so install it there through the app's own plugin surface (Settings → Plugins, or `dshmarket`); the CLI refuses that profile by design. ### From the CLI, for any profile the app does not own ```sh dsh plugin --profile add github:AomiRaku/dsh-accountDisplayName-edit ``` There is **no build step and no `prepare` script**: the browser half is committed as `lib/client.js`, so pnpm never asks for build approval and the install is a plain file copy. ### Manually, which is exactly what the commands above do 1. Put the package where the profile resolves its bundles — `/profiles//node_modules/dsh-accountdisplayname-edit`. A directory junction/symlink to a checkout works. 2. Add this to `/profiles//cordis.patch.yml`: ```yaml - insert: - id: account-display-name-edit name: dsh-accountdisplayname-edit ``` That patch layer is watched, so it applies live — no restart needed. ## Use 1. Click the account row at the bottom of the sidebar. 2. Choose **Edit display name**. 3. Optionally click **Choose image…** and pick a PNG / JPG / WebP; the round preview shows the cropped result. **Clear avatar** goes back to the account's own avatar. 4. Type the name you want. Save an empty value to go back to the account's own text. 5. Click **Save**. Nothing changes until you do. ## Screenshots The account menu, with the **Edit display name** row added under Settings, and the chosen name and avatar on the launcher below it: ![The account menu with the Edit display name row](assets/screenshot-1.png) The editor dialog: avatar preview, name field, and Save / Cancel / Use default: ![The editor dialog](assets/screenshot-2.png) ## Uninstall Remove the insert from `cordis.patch.yml` and delete the package directory. The stored name and avatar stay in the browser's `localStorage` until you clear them; the plugin writes nothing else. ## How it works A dual-face plugin whose host half does almost nothing. - **Host half — `lib/index.js`.** Deliberately import-free. Its only job is to be a Loader entry, so the host's client-module scanner reads `dsh.client` from `package.json` and serves `./client` to the browser. With no dependencies and no `peerDependencies`, it cannot fail to load because of a missing, renamed or version-mismatched peer package. - **Browser half — `lib/client.js`.** A hand-written single-file bundle, already in the `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` form the module system serves verbatim, so the package needs no build. It requires only `react`, which the shell seeds as a platform module — which is why `react` is not a dependency either. ### Why the menu row is done in the DOM `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-settings-account` renders that menu from a hard-coded `items` array, and its only slot (`settings.launcher`, a `single` slot) is the launcher row itself. Occupying that slot would delete 设置 / 意见反馈 / 退出登录, which this plugin must not do. There is no menu-item slot to add to. So the row is appended to the **open** menu's list, cloned from a shipped row — it therefore inherits that build's exact markup, classes and styling. Appending one node leaves React's own children untouched, and the row is removed with the menu because React never tracked it. Selectors use only stable identifiers, never a hashed CSS-module prefix: - the launcher is `button[aria-haspopup="menu"][data-signed-out]`, an attribute the account component always writes; the text node is found by the `_label` suffix and the avatar by the `_avatar` suffix, with positional fallbacks; - the menu is a `div[role="menu"]` the `Menu` primitive portals to ``, identified as the one that appeared after the launcher was activated. ### How the avatar is replaced The avatar span's real contents are React's — an `` or an initial.
